//: Template documenting every configuration key the API requires. Copy the RELEVANT
//_1: keys into User Secrets for local development (dotnet user-secrets set "Jwt:SecretKey" "...")
//_2: or into environment variables for deployment (Jwt__SecretKey=..., double underscore).
//_3: NEVER commit real values. appsettings.json ships with empty placeholders on purpose and
//_4: the application fails fast at startup when a required key is missing or blank.

Cors.//: Exact web origins allowed to call this API (scheme + host + port, no trailing slash).
Cors.//_1: Empty in Development falls back to the local Vite dev server origin.

Jwt.//: SecretKey is REQUIRED and must be at least 32 characters (256 bits) for HMAC-SHA256.

Smtp.//: Optional. When Host or Pass is blank the app falls back to a file-based email sender.

AiNode.//: InternalApiKey is REQUIRED. Pre-shared key for machine-to-machine calls with the AI service.

Encryption.//: REQUIRED. Base64-encoded 32-byte (256-bit) AES key used to encrypt EMPLOYEE_PROFILE.NationalId and Salary at rest.
Encryption.//_2: Rotating this key makes existing encrypted columns unreadable - re-encrypt before rotating.

LeavePolicy.//: Optional. Days a Draft leave request may sit untouched before the cleanup job cancels it.

DataRetention.//: Optional. Days to keep records before the retention job purges them. 0 or negative disables a purge.
